name: clonerrr
description: Marketing research for mobile apps: real video ads that apps ran on Facebook and Instagram, broken down scene by scene, and an audit of any App Store or Google Play listing against its competitors.

interface.longDescription:
Clonerrr is a marketing research tool for the people who grow mobile apps: founders, marketers and user acquisition teams. It does two jobs. It shows you real app ads and how they are built, and it audits an app's store listing against its competitors.

Ad research: search a library of real video ads that apps ran on Facebook and Instagram, taken from Meta's Ad Library. Open any ad to see why it works and how it is built, scene by scene: what each scene is for, the words on screen, the voiceover, how it is shot, and which parts belong to the original app and which carry over to any product. Where an ad's run was recorded, you also see how many days it ran. Give your app's App Store or Google Play link, or describe an app that is not live yet, to get the ads closest to it and write a new script on a structure that has already been used.

Store listing audits: audit an App Store or Google Play listing against the apps it competes with. Title and description, the searches it ranks for, screenshots, recent reviews and paid ads are each graded, with the changes that matter most in order. The full report is kept at a link you can open and share.

Good to know: the library covers ads for mobile apps and is a sample, so an app with no ads in it may still advertise. Days running is the only performance figure it holds; it has no spend, install or click data. The plugin reads public store listings and needs no account. It does not run, buy or publish ads.
capabilities: Search app ads by app, category or hook
Break down an ad scene by scene
Find ads that fit your app
Audit an App Store or Google Play listing

positive.description: Find real ads from an app category
positive.prompt: Show me real ads from health and fitness apps.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists ads from Health & Fitness apps in Clonerrr's library, each with the app, its opening line, its scene structure and a link to its page on clonerrr.com. Where an ad's run was recorded it also says how many days the ad ran; where none was, it says so rather than ranking them.

positive.description: Break one ad down scene by scene
positive.prompt: Search Clonerrr for CoinSnap ads, then break the first one down scene by scene.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a CoinSnap ad, then explains why it works and walks through its scenes in order: each scene's job, the words on screen, the voiceover and how it is shot, and what belongs to CoinSnap against what any product could reuse. Links the ad's page.

positive.description: Match ads to an app from its store link and write a script
positive.prompt: Here is my app: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/planespot-identify-any-plane/id6736696480 Which ads would fit it? Write a script from the best one.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the app from its App Store listing, proposes two or three library ads with the reason each fits, then writes a new scene-by-scene script for the app on one ad's structure with new wording, and links the source ad.

positive.description: Match ads to an app that is not live yet
positive.prompt: I'm building a habit tracker for students. It isn't in the App Store yet. Which ad structures should I look at?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the description instead of a store link and returns library ads to consider, saying which come from the same category and which are the closest from other categories, with links.

Calls run_app_audit, and again with the same link while its status is "running" (a new audit takes a minute or two). Once it is "done", gives the store score, the section scores, the headline and the changes that matter most in order, and links the full report on clonerrr.com.

negative.description: Running or buying ads is not supported
negative.prompt: Launch this ad on Facebook for my app with a $500 budget.

negative.description: Spend and results data are not available
negative.prompt: How much did CoinSnap spend on that ad, and what was its click-through rate?

negative.description: The audit covers App Store and Google Play listings only
negative.prompt: Audit the SEO of my website: https://example.com

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payment. Its tools read Clonerrr's public ad library and public App Store and Google Play listings, and its links open pages on clonerrr.com that anyone can read without an account.

publication.release_notes: First release: search the ad library, break down an ad scene by scene, find the ads that fit an app, and audit a store listing.
